title.en: In, at and on in other expressions; by
title.es: In, at y on en otras expresiones; by

summary.en: Many fixed expressions need a particular preposition that you simply have to learn: _on the radio_, _in the newspaper_, _at university_, _on holiday_. **By** has several common uses: means of transport and communication (_by train_, _by email_), the person or thing that does something (_written by_), and "next to" (_by the window_).
summary.es: Muchas de estas expresiones no coinciden con el español: «de vacaciones» es on holiday, «en la tele» es on TV, «en el autobús» es on the bus. Conviene aprenderlas como bloques.

form: **in**: _in the newspaper_, _in a photo_, _in hospital_, _in the corner_, _in the end_ (finally), _in time_ (early enough)
**at**: _at university_, _at work_, _at the back_, _at the top_, _at the end of_, _at first_, _at the moment_
**on**: _on TV_, _on the radio_, _on the phone_, _on holiday_, _on foot_, _on the left/right_, _on the bus/train/plane_, _on time_ (punctual)
**by**: _by car/bus/train_, _by email/post_, _by mistake/accident/chance_, _by myself_, _written by Orwell_, _by the sea_, _by working hard_

uses.text: **Media and communication**: _on TV_, _on the radio_, _on the phone_, _on the internet_, but _in the newspaper_, _in a magazine_, _in a letter_.
**Places without an article**, when we mean the activity: _in hospital_ (as a patient), _at university_, _at work_, _in bed_.

note.en: In British English, in hospital and at university are the usual forms.
note.es: Sin the cuando hablamos de la función: She's in hospital = está ingresada.

uses.text: **Transport**: _on_ for public transport and bikes (_on the bus_, _on a plane_, _on my bike_), _in_ for cars and taxis (_in the car_, _in a taxi_). With **by** there is no article: _by bus_, _by taxi_.
**Position**: _on the left_, _on the right_, _at the back_, _at the top_, _in the middle_. Compare _in the corner of the room_ with _on the corner of the street_.
**By**: _by mistake_, _by chance_, _by myself_ (alone), _by the window_ (next to), _a novel **by** Orwell_, _You learn **by** listening._
**Pairs that differ**: _in time_ (early enough) / _on time_ (punctual); _in the end_ (finally) / _at the end of_ (the last part of something).

mistakes.wrong: We are in holidays in August.
mistakes.right: We are on holiday in August.

why.en: The fixed expression is on holiday, singular.
why.es: «De vacaciones» es on holiday, en singular.

mistakes.wrong: I go to work with the bus.
mistakes.right: I go to work by bus.

why.en: Means of transport takes by, with no article. You can also say on the bus.
why.es: No se traduce «con el autobús»: by bus (sin artículo) o on the bus.

mistakes.wrong: I saw her in the TV last night.
mistakes.right: I saw her on TV last night.

why.en: We say on TV, on the radio and on the internet.

mistakes.wrong: The toilets are at the left, next to the lift.
mistakes.right: The toilets are on the left, next to the lift.

why.en: We say on the left and on the right.
why.es: «A la izquierda» es on the left.

examples.en: I read about the closure in the local newspaper.
Is there anything good on TV tonight?
She's on the phone to her bank.
examples.es: Está hablando por teléfono con su banco.

examples.en: My brother is at university in Leeds.
He was in hospital for two weeks after the accident.
We're going on holiday to Crete in June.
The lift is on the left, just past reception.
We arrived on time, but we weren't in time to catch the opening speech.
I got your message by mistake; it was meant for someone else.
examples.es: Me llegó tu mensaje por error; era para otra persona.

examples.en: They travelled around Peru by bus and on foot.
A novel by a young Nigerian writer won the prize.

practice.prompt: I saw an interesting article ___ the newspaper this morning.

explanation.en: We say in the newspaper, in a magazine.
Means of transport without an article takes by.

practice.prompt: I'm sorry, I took your umbrella ___ mistake.

explanation.en: The fixed expression is by mistake.

practice.prompt: The match is ___ TV tonight at nine.

explanation.en: We say on TV and on the radio.

practice.prompt: We're ___ holiday in Crete until the end of the month.

explanation.en: The fixed expression is on holiday.
